reviews.text: The receptionist and the doctor were both very kind and helpful, providing clear explanations and demonstrating excellent customer service.

I recently took my rabbit to the vet.

It started gagging while eating, so I rushed it in.

The vet said there was nothing particularly wrong. They said it was just a slight blockage, like in humans, and only performed an internal examination before prescribing antibiotics.

The rabbit passed away the next day.

I regret that they couldn't have examined it more thoroughly.

I visited the clinic unexpectedly in the middle of the night, but they responded immediately and even though it was quite late, they examined me thoroughly until the end. The doctor was excellent. It's a bit far, so it's inconvenient to go there often, but I would like to ask for their help again if I have any other problems.

There were no animal hospitals open after 8 PM, and my regular vet was closed, so I searched online and called.
The person on the phone was very polite, and I was willing to pay the extra fee for after 8 PM to have my pet seen. When I asked to confirm the location, "Is it in Doshin-cho, Kita-ku? Is it close to OAP?", they replied, "No, it's between Sakuranomiya and Tenma, near Sakuranomiya Station." I asked further, "Sakuranomiya Station? So I don't have to cross the Okawa River from Sakuranomiya Station? (Is it in Miyakojima-ku instead of Kita-ku?)" and they said, "You do have to cross the river." I was completely confused and decided not to go. I had said I was coming by car from outside the prefecture, and I asked for a general landmark like OAP, but they only gave me detailed directions...
After hanging up, I checked the map and OAP was indeed nearby. Please give me clear directions or instructions on how to get to your clinic.

I brought my rabbit in for an examination.

She had a spaying surgery at another clinic, but she picked at the wound, causing it to reopen. This was my first visit to your clinic.

Even though it was past 8 PM, they accepted her and said they could stitch it up urgently, quickly gathering staff to help.

Thanks to them, she's now full of energy.

I'm truly grateful!

Thank you very much.
They always treat me kindly, and it's a trustworthy hospital! I've moved and it's a little further away now, but I think this is the only doctor I'll ever need!

At the end of November last year, my 12-year-old dog started breathing heavily and became unwell. Unfortunately, my regular hospital was closed, so I dropped in to this hospital in the evening. He was hospitalized for four days and given medication, but the hospital was very thorough in explaining his condition at the time of admission and when I visited, as well as any suspected illnesses and treatments. When he was discharged, they provided me with a detailed report to send to my regular hospital, as well as image data such as X-rays and CT scans, which allowed me to smoothly continue treatment with my regular doctor. I am very grateful.

My cat went to the vet because she was sick. She's still young and scared to go outside, so she keeps meowing.

Until now, Dr. Yamashita had been treating her; he was kind and thorough, which put my mind at ease.

However, Dr. Yamashita was off today, and Dr. Oka was there instead.

I was outside the examination room, but I could hear Dr. Oka yelling loudly at my cat, scolding her to "be quiet."

I don't think someone who treats an animal crying out of fear like that is qualified to be a doctor.

My two cats were under their care for nearly 10 years.

There's nothing wrong with the doctors, but the receptionist's attitude is just awful.

She constantly makes unnecessary remarks, making every visit unpleasant.

Because we've had pet checkups and have a long history there, I hesitated to change hospitals, thinking it was only about once a month, and I kept going.

But I've finally reached my limit.

I will never go there again.

They were very kind and helpful even at a late hour. Both the receptionist and the vet were incredibly polite and prioritized my dog's well-being, providing truly exceptional care. Thanks to them, my dog ​​is now fully recovered and healthy ❤️‍🩹☺️ …

I don't even want to give it a star rating; this hospital is only concerned with making money. I was prescribed a makeshift anti-nausea medication, which I couldn't vomit, and the next day it got stuck in my intestines, so I had to have surgery. The pointless and irresponsible tests and treatments put me in a life-threatening condition. I want to sue them. I'm never going there again.
The doctors are kind, and vaccinations can be booked online, which is convenient.

The other night, after a walk, my legs suddenly became immobile, so I came here after seeing that you offer nighttime consultations. I arrived just before closing time, but you kindly accepted me, and the doctor examined me very carefully and explained everything thoroughly, which put me at ease. Thanks to you, I was able to walk the next day. Thank you very much.
My child had undergone dental treatment under general anesthesia at another hospital during the day, but remained unconscious and continued to have seizures, so I sought your help at night. …

I always come here to get my cat's nails trimmed.
My cat is quite rowdy, but the doctors and nurses are all very kind and helpful. …

I took my rabbit to the doctor for a loss of appetite. 
The doctor suggested the possibility of ulcerative colitis and prescribed related treatment and medication (15,000 yen), but a second opinion revealed that the cause was an injury inside the rabbit's mouth.

No appointment is necessary; you can visit our clinic.

We can also accommodate requests for appointments and specific veterinarians. We …

I've been a patient here for many years. They thoroughly examine my dog's current condition, provide detailed explanations, and even advise me on things to watch out for in the future, making it a reassuring hospital for me as a pet owner of an elderly dog.

It's a little far from my home, but I've been going there for years and feel at ease because the staff are always kind enough to listen to what I have to say.
